numbering: Episodes numbered 1–37 in broadcast order; the series is a single 37-episode run.

arcs.name: Kira vs. L
arcs.summary: Top student Light Yagami finds a notebook that kills anyone whose name is written in it and sets out to purge the world of criminals. The mysterious detective L takes up the case.
events: Light meets the shinigami Ryuk, the notebook's original owner.
L baits Light into revealing that Kira is in the Kanto region.
Light kills FBI agent Raye Penber and his colleagues.
L enrolls at Light's university and reveals himself to Light.

arcs.name: The Second Kira
arcs.summary: Video tapes from a second Kira appear, and the copycat is desperate to meet the original.
events: Misa Amane trades half her life for Shinigami Eyes and tracks Light down.
L detains Light and Misa as suspects.
Light gives up ownership of the notebook and loses his memories to clear his name.

arcs.name: Yotsuba
arcs.summary: Kira's killings continue as a corporation uses them to get ahead, and an amnesiac Light hunts Kira alongside L.
events: The task force traps Kyosuke Higuchi of the Yotsuba Group as the third Kira.
Light regains his memories when he touches the notebook again.
Rem kills Watari and L to protect Misa, and dies herself.

arcs.name: Mello and Near
arcs.summary: Years later, Light leads the investigation into himself while L's two heirs, Near and Mello, come after Kira.
events: Mello kidnaps the police director's daughter to get the notebook, and Soichiro Yagami dies after the raid.
Light enlists Teru Mikami and Kiyomi Takada as Kira's agents.
Near exposes Light at the Yellow Box warehouse, and Ryuk writes Light's name.

filler.note: No filler: every episode adapts the manga.
